A '''Stormdriver''' owned by [[Zodoh]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] was destroyed during an [[Battle of Capital Cay|attack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aquilaris Minor]]. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], Zodoh launched an invasion of an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] known as the [[Daimanate]] while its ruler, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Daiman]], was away. Zodoh personally led a strike force in an attack on the Daimanate world of Aquilaris, inflicting heavy damage on the Sith forces before dispatching the [[Stormdriver]] to [[Capital Cay]] to use its [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporators]] to drain the [[Water/Legends|water]] from the bay in an attempt to initiate a storm which would flood the [[City/Legends|city]] and drown the surviving Sith. Before the Stormdriver could complete its mission, however, it was ambushed and destroyed by [[Devil Squadron]], a [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] of [[Fire Lotus-class starfighter|''Fire Lotus''-class starfighters]] led by [[Jenn Devaad]].
